rows.label: Burj Khalifa
rows.description: skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is the tallest building in the world, towering over its desert city

rows.label: Terracotta Army
rows.description: collection of ancient Chinese military statues
rows.hook: is a vast buried force of life-sized soldiers guarding a first emperor's tomb

rows.label: Rosetta Stone
rows.description: ancient Egyptian stele with inscriptions in three writing systems
rows.hook: let scholars crack Egyptian hieroglyphs by comparing its three scripts

rows.label: Kombucha
rows.description: tea fermented using a symbiosis of bacteria and yeast
rows.hook: is a fizzy, slightly sour fermented drink made with a floating culture called a SCOBY

rows.label: Spam
rows.description: brand of canned precooked meat product
rows.hook: is a canned meat from Hormel, famous in Hawaii and in a Monty Python sketch

rows.label: Moai
rows.description: monolithic humanoid figures
rows.hook: are giant carved stone heads standing on Easter Island

rows.label: Haggis
rows.description: savoury pudding containing lamb and oats of Scottish origin
rows.hook: is a Scottish dish traditionally boiled in a stomach casing and served on Burns Night

rows.label: Brandy
rows.description: spirit produced by distilling wine
rows.hook: is an after-dinner spirit served in a snifter, often aged in oak

rows.label: Compact disc
rows.description: digital optical disc data storage format
rows.hook: was the shiny music format that replaced cassettes in the final decades of the last century

rows.label: Gin
rows.description: distilled alcoholic drink
rows.hook: is the clear spirit that gives a martini its bite, paired with tonic in a classic highball

rows.label: Venus of Willendorf
rows.description: prehistoric figurine from Austria

rows.label: Cognac
rows.description: alcoholic beverage; variety of brandy
rows.hook: is a famous aged French spirit named for a town in the Charente region

rows.label: Mead
rows.description: alcoholic beverage made from honey
rows.hook: is an ancient golden drink that Vikings and medieval feasters were fond of

rows.label: Caviar
rows.description: salt-cured fish-eggs of the Acipenseridae family
rows.hook: is a luxury delicacy served on blinis and priced like gold

rows.label: Ketchup
rows.description: table condiment usually made of tomatoes
rows.hook: is the red condiment squeezed on fries and burgers

rows.label: Tempeh
rows.description: Indonesian soy product originated from Java island, used as protein source

rows.label: Concrete
rows.description: composite construction material
rows.hook: is the gray building material poured to make sidewalks, dams and foundations

rows.label: Miso
rows.description: fermented soybean paste
rows.hook: is a salty Japanese paste that flavors a famous breakfast soup

rows.label: Tzatziki
rows.description: cold cucumber-yogurt dip, soup, or sauce
rows.hook: is a cool Greek dip served with gyros

rows.label: Prosciutto
rows.description: Italian dry-cured ham
rows.hook: is a thinly sliced Italian cured ham often wrapped around melon

rows.label: US penny
rows.description: United States coin with a value of 1 cent

rows.label: Marzipan
rows.description: confection consisting primarily of sugar or honey and almond meal (ground almonds)
rows.hook: is a sweet, moldable candy often shaped into little fruits and cake decorations

rows.label: Bacon
rows.description: salt cured pork belly, back, or side, sometimes smoked
rows.hook: is the crispy breakfast strip that sizzles in a pan alongside eggs

rows.label: Porcelain
rows.description: ceramic material
rows.hook: is the fine, translucent china prized for delicate teacups and dinnerware

rows.label: Kevlar
rows.description: heat-resistant and strong aromatic polyamide fiber

rows.label: Tabasco
rows.description: American hot sauce brand
rows.hook: is a Louisiana red pepper sauce sold in tiny bottles with green caps

rows.label: Meringue
rows.description: sugar confectionery made from whipped egg whites and sugar
rows.hook: is the fluffy white topping baked into a lemon pie

rows.label: Salami
rows.description: cured sausage, fermented and air-dried meat
rows.hook: is an Italian deli sausage sliced thin and often found on charcuterie boards

rows.label: Pesto
rows.description: sauce made from basil, pine nuts, Parmigiano Reggiano, olive oil, and garlic
rows.hook: is a bright green Genoese sauce tossed with pasta
